design: Very broad older guard with mottled dusty-purple grey hide, massive uncovered heavy jaw mandibles, large blunt outer tusks and cranium with small pronounced ridge. Long thick dreadlocks with sparse copper cuffs, all swept backward. Rounded dark-metal cuirass made of three large overlapping chest plates, broad padded charcoal shoulder mantlet, wide bronze belt buckle, four distinct long skirt strips, scuffed shin guards. Left hand rests on large vertical oval alien shield grounded close to feet, right hand at hip with sheathed blade. Powerful relaxed silhouette.
